A monthly rating series has no source at all. The detail panel renders an empty chart area as a result.

Expect the disruption list to sum to less than the headline rate implies.

defects.name: Activity Not As Advertised
defects.description: The activity delivered did not match the description.
recommendations: Review the description of your activity so travelers know what to expect
Ensure your photos accurately reflect the experience

defects.name: Supplier Not Responsive
defects.description: The traveler contacted you and did not get a reply in time.
recommendations: Check your inbox daily, including the day before travel
Keep the phone number on your listing one a traveler can actually reach

defects.name: Unclear Meeting Point Location
defects.description: The meeting point description was unclear, or wrong.
recommendations: Verify the address is findable in a map app and add a meeting point photo
Include landmarks or directions from the nearest transport stop

defects.name: Extra Charge
defects.description: The traveler was asked to pay more than the booked price.
recommendations: Include every mandatory fee in the price shown on GetYourGuide
List genuinely optional extras in the Important Information section

defects.name: Unexpected Cancellation
defects.description: The activity was cancelled at short notice.
recommendations: Only keep availability open for slots you are confident you can run
Tell travelers as early as possible when something has to be cancelled

defects.name: Unsuitable For Disabled Customers
defects.description: The activity could not accommodate a traveler's accessibility needs.
recommendations: State accessibility limitations plainly in the Important Information section
Describe terrain, steps and transport so travelers can judge suitability

defects.name: Guide Language Wrong or Low Proficiency
defects.description: The guide did not speak the language originally booked for.
recommendations: Confirm which languages each guide can deliver and keep the option list in sync
Remove languages you cannot staff reliably rather than risk a mismatch

defects.name: Unclear Pickup Information
defects.description: The pickup details for the activity were missing, unclear or wrong.
recommendations: State the exact pickup address, and a time window rather than a single time
Add a photo of the pickup point so travelers can recognise it

defects.name: Pickup/Guide Late or No Show
defects.description: The guide or driver arrived late or did not show up at the pickup point.
recommendations: Build buffer time into pickup routes so one delay does not cascade
Message travelers as soon as you know a pickup will run late

defects.name: Change Pick Up Time
defects.description: The pickup time was changed after the traveler booked.
recommendations: Only publish pickup times you can staff for the whole season
Give travelers as much notice as possible when a time has to move
